entries.descriptionOriginal: Anubis Prefire Trainer Learn every angle on competitive Anubis. A shootable practice board drops you into T spawn with four long routes — B Site (Ruins and B Long into the site, then through Palace and Middle out to A Connector), Mid (Top Mid over the Bridge into Middle, then Palace and Back Site into B), Water (down the canal past Boat and E Box into B, then out to CT Spawn) and A Site (Upper and the Drop into A, then Heaven, Tunnel and Beach round to CT Spawn and Cave) — each pulling from a pool of around a hundred authored bot positions and dealing out a fresh subset every run, so no two attempts play the same. Every bot position is a real competitive angle, placed by advanced bot AI — and every one of them was then probed against the map's own floor and walked in-game. 3 bot difficulty presets, from passive to fully reactive Or go custom — aim, reaction speed, the bots' buy and how many bots you face are four separate dials, so you can train against bots that snap onto you but spray wide, or bots that aim perfectly but take a moment to notice you 6 weapons on the board, including the classic deagle-only drill — or just buy whatever you want from the buy menu and take it into the run Toggleable kevlar, infinite ammo, health regen on a kill, and peeking bots that wait behind cover and swing out on you as you reach the spot they're watching — over a hundred of them marked by hand in-game — all from the board, no menus The bots come at you in route order and never appear on ground you've already cleared — not behind you, not on a site you've just walked out of, and never on screen — and they never bunch up three-deep in one corner A guide line painted along the floor shows you the route and fades out right around you, so it never gets in the way of an angle Running low on frames? Shoot the switch in the corner of the board — it drops the guide line, the decoration and the menu itself, and fields fewer bots at a time. Same routes, same angles, same scoring Die and you're straight back into the same run Clear every bot and the board shows your time, deaths, and shot count Your best time is saved per route, difficulty, and gun — and shoot HIST to see every cleared run charted over time: your time, time-to-kill, accuracy and headshot accuracy Built as a clean overlay on the real, unmodified competitive Anubis — nothing about the map itself is touched.

Пустынные улочки, узкие коридоры, яркие солнечные лучи и фирменная архитектура Ближнего Востока всё это сохраняет оригинальную атмосферу Sandstone, но раскрывает её в совершенно новом качестве.
